title: Identification and removal of nano-/micro-plastics using nanostructured materials: from fundamentals to environmental applications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,2164-2210
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01001B, Critical Review
Jai Prakash, Nikita Sharma, Rupam Sharma, Sahil Thakur, Samriti Sharma, Pradeep Kumar, Farikhatul Fitria, Sakthivel Gandhi, K. S. Shalini Devi, Hideki Kuramitz, Mikhael Bechelany
The role of nanostructured materials in effective sensing, identification, and removal of NMPs from the environment is reviewed, emphasizing their unique structural and functional properties.
